finalText:
I'll start by reading DESIGN.md, the frozen contract, and the existing renderer files in parallel.
Next, the Orca reference styles, the ported primitives, and the e2e scripts.
The hero shows dark tabs with a lighter active tab and a compact status bar. Next I'll pull the exact Orca class strings for those pieces and check the remaining primitives.
Next: build/test config, the Terminal and Sidebar CSS I need to coexist with, and the context-menu exports.
I have most of the context. Before writing code I need to check a few details: whether Ctrl+N is already bound, the attention colour mapping, the `dark` class in index.html, the context-menu export names, and the tsconfig strictness flags.
Ctrl+N is already bound by the sidebar (Sidebar.tsx:94), so I won't bind it again in the shell. Last check: the attention colour mapping and the Orca tab-strip `+`/close classes.
I have what I need. Setting up the task list, then writing the tests first.
Tests are written and currently fail (no implementation yet). Now the pure logic module.
Two fixes before running: `removeTabs` uses a cast I don't need, and `closeOthersTabs` should be a no-op when the kept id is not open (the test name already says that).
Next, the small pure helpers: stored preferences (with safe storage access) and the tab indicator mapping.
All 48 pure-logic tests pass. Moving on to the hooks: the open-tabs reducer, the shortcut listener, and the persisted preferences.
I left a bug in that draft: the `closeOthers` wrapper removes tabs before the close succeeds, and there's a stray export at the bottom. Rewriting the file cleanly, and dropping the now-unused `closeOthersTabs` (the batch remove covers it).
Now I'm removing `closeOthersTabs` from the pure module and its test, since nothing uses it anymore.
Now the persisted-boolean hook, the sound hook, and the window shortcut listener.
Hooks are in place. Before writing the components I need to check whether anything outside App relies on the old `app__*` classes or the `:root` variables in styles.css, since those would collide with the Orca tokens.
Important finding: `theme.css` (still used by the sidebar and dialogs) defines `--accent` and `--border` with values that differ from Orca's dark tokens. The shell will scope Orca's values back in, and I'll flag this in the report. I also need two small pure helpers for the tab models and the status-bar folder name, so I'm adding their tests first.
The PowerShell here-string edit broke on quoting. I'll rewrite the whole file with the write tool instead.
All 53 shell tests pass. Now the components, starting with the small ones.
Now the tab bar, with the sidebar-restore button, the strip, and the `+` button.
Now the status bar.
Next, shrinking styles.css to the shell-only rules, then rewriting App.tsx.
I left an eslint-disable comment in there, and this project has no eslint config. Removing it.
Next, the e2e script: one check that the tab strip shows the selected session, and one that closing via the API stops the process and sets `closedAt`.
Shell files are written. Running the web typecheck to see what's left, expecting only the sidebar-worker members to be missing.
The errors are in the Sidebar folder, which the other worker is editing right now. I'll check the current state of that folder and the store before drawing conclusions.
The sidebar worker has landed `closeSession`/`reopenSession` in the store, but `Sidebar.tsx` itself isn't there yet. My files typecheck clean. Re-running the shell tests and the full suite to confirm nothing else regressed.
All 640 tests across the repo pass. Quick syntax check on the edited e2e script and a final typecheck pass on the web project.
Everything in my scope typechecks; the remaining errors are in `Sidebar/` and `state/selectors.test.ts`, which belong to the sidebar worker. Marking the task list complete.
SUMMARY:
- Shell rebuilt: `App.tsx` now renders the sidebar column (300px, collapsible, top row with name and toggle), the tab bar, the terminal area with empty state, and the status bar.
- Open tabs are a pure, tested reducer (`openTabsLogic.ts`) with persistence, pruning, neighbour selection on close, and Ctrl+W / Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab. Closing a tab calls `actions.closeSession` and only drops the tab after it succeeds.
- Tab, tab bar, status bar, empty state and title-bar region are in `src/renderer/shell/`, using Orca class strings and the `ui/*` primitives.
- Window overlay space is reserved via `env(titlebar-area-*)`; `styles.css` is cut down to drag regions, that reserve, and a scoped `.app-shell` token fix.
- `scripts/e2e.cjs` gained a tab-selected check and a closedAt check. `e2e-resume.cjs` needed no changes (it uses no UI selectors).
- Build and e2e are not run: `Sidebar.tsx` has not landed yet.

FILES CHANGED:
- src/renderer/App.tsx (rewritten)
- src/renderer/styles.css (shrunk to shell rules)
- src/renderer/shell/openTabsLogic.ts + openTabsLogic.test.ts
- src/renderer/shell/shellPrefs.ts + shellPrefs.test.ts
- src/renderer/shell/tabStatus.ts + tabStatus.test.ts
- src/renderer/shell/useOpenTabs.ts, useTabShortcuts.ts, usePersistedBoolean.ts, useSoundEnabled.ts
- src/renderer/shell/TitleBarRegion.tsx, Tab.tsx, TabBar.tsx, StatusBar.tsx, EmptyState.tsx
- scripts/e2e.cjs

COMMANDS RUN + RESULT:
- `npx vitest run src/renderer/shell`: 3 files, 53 tests passed, 0 failed.
- `npx vitest run` (whole repo): 31 files, 640 tests passed, 0 failed.
- `npm run typecheck:web`: zero errors in my files. Remaining errors are not mine: `Sidebar/index.ts` (cannot find `./Sidebar`, file mid-rewrite), `Sidebar/SessionsHeader.tsx` and `Sidebar/uiLogic.ts` (unused `Group`), `state/selectors.test.ts:427` (unused `todo`).
- `node --check scripts/e2e.cjs`: pass.
- `npm run build`: not run, blocked on Sidebar landing.
- `npm run e2e` / `e2e:resume`: not run, need a built Electron app and the sidebar.

OPEN QUESTIONS / ASSUMPTIONS:
- Sidebar contract: `App` passes `onReopen={tabs.reopen}`, and `SessionActions` already has `closeSession`/`reopenSession`. Until `Sidebar` lands, its props are untyped, so `onReopen` is unverified.
- Token collision: `theme.css` (still used by sidebar and dialogs) sets `--accent` and `--border` to values different from Orca. `.app-shell` in `styles.css` restores Orca's dark values for the shell subtree, so the sidebar inside it sees Orca's values too. Dialogs are portalled outside it and keep the old look. Phase C should remove `theme.css`.
- `Terminal/Terminal.css` paints `.terminal-host` at `#1e1e1e` with 8px padding. The shell uses `bg-background` (#0a0a0a). The Terminal owner should switch to the Orca token.
- Ctrl+W and Ctrl+Tab are captured even when the terminal has focus (xterm's textarea is not treated as text entry). Ctrl+W therefore closes the session and no longer reaches Claude as readline "delete word". Ctrl+N is not bound here because the sidebar already binds it.
- The active-tab indicator is on the top edge, as the brief says. Orca's own indicator is on the bottom.
- Selecting a closed session in the sidebar is ignored; it must go through `onReopen`.
- When the sidebar is collapsed, a "Show sidebar" button appears at the left of the tab bar.

NOT DONE:
- `npm run build` and `npm run e2e` / `e2e:resume` are not run; they need the sidebar worker's `Sidebar.tsx`.
- Hook-level behaviour (`useOpenTabs`, `useTabShortcuts`) has no DOM tests; the node test environment cannot exercise it, so its logic is covered only through the pure functions.
- Visual comparison against `readme-hero.jpg` has not been done.
